Harper: Tiny idea  carry-on snack exchange? people bring one small thing from a trip and leave at the kitchen for others to try next Wed at 3pm. low-effort. :seedling:
Evan: love. quick add-on: include a 'time-to-serve' note (under 5min / 10-20 / needs prep). helps layover folks.
Priya: If you're doing under-30min airport picks: Amsterdam Schiphols stroopwafel stand near lounge 2 is instant and portable. buy a packet.
Marco: For short layovers at YYZ, the kiosks by Gate C have butter tarts (small bakery stall) and they're grab-and-go. avoid sit-downs.
Anya: Quick hotel minibar hack: bring the tiny local candy bars instead of the overpriced chips. good for novelty samples.
Leo: For any ICN travelers: Gimpo/ICN both have wrapped egg sandwiches that are <7min prep and super filling. great for early flights.
Harper: @Evan good call, i'll add columns: origin, vendor, 3-ingredient list, allergen flags, prep time. i'll drop a sheet link in here.
TacoBot: :taco: Poll created: "Snack exchange focus: regional small bites / sweets / mix" (react to vote)
Evan: Porto rec: Francesinha mini-sandwich from a takeout window is doable if you have ~20min. heavy but delicious.
Priya: Tokyo Narita pro-tip: the on-the-go onigiri stalls in Terminal 2 are the fastest option. look for plastic-wrapped ones.
Marco: For downtown SF crowd: if you're grabbing for a meeting, SFO's new express salad kiosks in Terminal G are <5min and decent.
Anya: I'll bring something nut-free from Lisbon (pastel de nata mini sample) and label it vegan option? (it's not vegan duh) i'll label properly.
Leo: If anyone's doing busy EU layovers, prioritize outlets with visible heated cases. Makes ordering much faster.
Harper: Sheet is up: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample (placeholder)  sign up with origin + prep time + allergens. meetup 3pm Wed in the kitchen island.
Evan: i'll bring a tiny tin of Garrett popcorn (blessed airport purchase) and a note about queue times.
Priya: tagging @TacoBot for a reminder Wednesday 2:45pm. excited. :raised_hands:
